mechanism: Cenobamate is a CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer that may decrease celecoxib plasma concentrations, potentially reducing anti-inflammatory efficacy, while celecoxib may increase cenobamate levels through CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor celecoxib efficacy and consider dose adjustment; monitor cenobamate levels and watch for toxicity signs; counsel on timing of administration.
